ReCAP’s authors report Qwen earned a 28.5 reward on the 106-task SWE-Together benchmark versus 24.4 for full-history prompting, with 46% fewer context tokens.
On the 100-task Lost-in-Conversation coding suite, ReCAP reports Qwen at 85.4 versus 65.6 for full history; the paper tests only two coding suites and a small set of backbones.
